global: This is tonkotsu ramen, its rich, creamy broth glowing warmly. Toppings—nori, chashu, menma, and naruto—are artfully arranged. Served in a blue-patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under soft, ambient light.

regions.background: Light wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and soft reflections, oval-shaped in the frame.
regions.bowl: Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate floral pattern and raised rim, glossy finish.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is rich, golden-brown, and glossy, with thin noodles swirling beneath its surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, and irregularly shaped with a rough, textured surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is pinkish-brown, tender-looking, thinly sliced, and speckled with black pepper.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale tan, with fibrous texture, irregular cylindrical shape, and visible dark specks on their surface.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pink-swirled white slice, smooth surface, slightly translucent, oval shape with soft edges.
